task: Improve Workspace Monitor speed and verify static output with browser automation.

resource_risks.description: The UI now fetches the large workspace snapshot as a separate JSON resource.
resource_risks.mitigation: The fetch is one-shot in SnapshotLoader with cancellation guard on unmount and uses no recurring timers or retained handles.

resource_risks.description: Verification started a local static HTTP server.
resource_risks.mitigation: The server was run in a tracked exec session and stopped with Ctrl-C after Playwright verification.
The Playwright script explicitly closed the browser after the smoke check.

lifecycle_checks.cleanup_path: The effect sets a cancellation flag on unmount and does not retain interval/timer resources.
Sent Ctrl-C to the tracked exec session after smoke completion.
evidence: server session exited after Keyboard interrupt

notes: No new long-running production worker, polling loop, or subprocess was added.
